chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about a man who brought his cheetah into the Haram: is he allowed to take it out? He said:
"It is a predator, so whatever predator you bring into the Haram as a captive, you may take it out."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Can a captive predatory animal that was brought into the Haram be taken out?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning predatory animals brought into the sacred sanctuary. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that if such a beast entered the Haram as a captive, it is permissible to remove it from there.
